items.statement: Each named molecule is optimized before property extraction, with the azo bond and alpha nitrogen retained by identity.
items.expected: Auditable optimized structures and convergence/stationarity evidence are supplied for Azo-pNO2 and Azo-pCN.

items.statement: The BDE is computed from the azo-containing parent and dissociation fragments using a consistent convention.
items.expected: Parent and two fragment energies, fragment charge/spin states, and the BDE equation/sign convention are reported for both IDs.

items.statement: Azo-pNO2 has the more positive alpha-nitrogen charge of the two released molecules.
items.expected: The submitted comparison identifies Azo-pNO2 above Azo-pCN in alpha-nitrogen charge, subject to the stated charge convention.

items.statement: The reported Table 1 values are Azo-pNO2 charge -0.033 e and BDE 451.81 kJ/mol, and Azo-pCN charge -0.063 e and BDE 449.81 kJ/mol.
items.expected: Per-ID numerical values are close to those Table 1 values under the submitted convention.
